extDescription.message: A clean, elegant Chrome new tab page with bookmark management, visit-frequency sorting, and WebDAV cloud sync.

emptyDesc.message: Click the + button in the top-right corner to start adding your favorite sites

confirmDeleteGroup.message: Bookmarks in this group will be moved to the default group. Delete this group?

importParseFailed.message: Import failed: the file format is invalid or could not be parsed

importMissingBookmarks.message: Import failed: the file format is invalid (missing bookmarks data)

importNothing.message: Import finished: the file contains no bookmarks to import

importDone.message: Import finished: $added$ bookmarks added, $skipped$ duplicates skipped, $groups$ new groups created

syncPasswordKeep.message: Password saved, leave empty to keep it

syncPasswordPlaceholder.message: Leave empty to keep the saved password

syncNote.message: The first sync merges local and remote bookmarks (deduplicated by URL) and never overwrites either side. The account and password are stored only in the local browser; use the app-specific password provided by your service.

providerJianguoyunHint.message: Use your registered email as the account; for the key, use the app password generated under Account Info > Security Options > Third-party app management.

providerPcloudHint.message: Use your pCloud email as the account and your password as the key (an app-specific password is recommended).

providerYandexHint.message: Use your Yandex email as the account; for the key use the app password, not the login password.

providerInfiniCloudHint.message: Replace your-server with the server name assigned to you at registration.

providerNextcloudHint.message: Replace your-host and your-username; the address must end with /.

providerSynologyHint.message: Enable WebDAV Server in DSM first; the default HTTPS port is 5006.

providerAlistHint.message: AList defaults to port 5244; plain local HTTP addresses work too.

providerCustomHint.message: Enter the URL of an existing WebDAV directory; it must end with /. The sync file is written into that directory.

syncSavedFirstFailed.message: Config saved, but the first sync failed: $reason$

syncUrlRequiredFirst.message: Please enter the WebDAV address first

confirmDisableSync.message: Disable cloud sync? Local bookmarks will not be deleted.

syncDisabled.message: Cloud sync is off, local data is unchanged

backgroundNoResponse.message: No response from the background script

syncUrlInvalid.message: Invalid WebDAV address: it must start with http:// or https://

syncOriginDenied.message: This domain is not authorized, so syncing is not possible

addFailed.message: Failed to add, please try again!

bgUrlInvalid.message: The WebDAV address must start with http:// or https://

bgOriginNotGranted.message: This WebDAV domain is not authorized yet; save the sync settings again to grant access

bgAuth401.message: Authentication failed (401): the account or app password is incorrect

bgForbidden403.message: Permission denied (403): check the WebDAV address and the account permissions

bgNotFound404.message: Path not found (404): make sure the WebDAV address is an existing directory

bgMethodNotAllowed405.message: The server does not allow this operation (405): make sure the address is a WebDAV directory

bgConflict409.message: Directory not found (409): create the sync directory in your drive first

bgInsufficientStorage507.message: Not enough space on the drive (507)

bgNetworkError.message: Could not connect to the WebDAV server: check the address, whether the domain is authorized, and the network or HTTPS certificate

bgRemoteInvalidJson.message: The remote sync file is not valid JSON and may have been corrupted by another program

bgSyncConflict.message: Sync conflict: the remote file is being modified by another device, please retry later

bgSyncUrlMissing.message: Please configure the WebDAV address first

bgTestNoRemoteFile.message: Connection succeeded, no sync file on the remote side yet (the first sync will create it)

bgTestAuthFailed.message: Authentication failed: the account or app password is incorrect

bgTestForbidden.message: Permission denied: check the directory path and the account permissions

bgTestWrongFormat.message: The remote file exists but is not in this extension's sync format

bgTestSuccess.message: Connection succeeded, remote sync file found

bgSyncFileNotObject.message: The sync file does not contain a valid JSON object

bgSyncFileUnknownFormat.message: Unrecognized sync file format (missing bookmarks data)
